$comment: C2P Tech Hub — canonical data model for the Student Directory entity. Every record in this file is a generated placeholder (is_placeholder: true) and MUST be replaced with real member data before the directory is published. JavaScript is prohibited by the project constraints, so this file is NOT fetched at runtime; directory.html mirrors these records as static HTML. This file is nevertheless the editing surface: change a record here, then update the corresponding row in directory.html.

fields.id: string (required, unique) — stable key, prefix 'stu-', zero-padded to three digits so records sort correctly as strings.
fields.name: string (required) — the member's full name as they wish it displayed.
fields.initials: string (required, 2 chars) — precomputed monogram for the avatar. Stored rather than derived because deriving it in the browser would require JavaScript, which the project constraints forbid.
fields.level: string (required) — year of study in the Nigerian university convention. One of: 100L | 200L | 300L | 400L | 500L.
fields.department: string (required) — the member's home department. The hub sits in Computer Engineering but is open to students from any department, so this is not a constant.
fields.focus_area: string (required) — the technical area the member works in. Used for mentor matching and for grouping the directory.
fields.project: string (required) — title of the hub project the member is currently attached to. Corresponds to a title in projects.json.
fields.is_placeholder: boolean (required) — true for every record currently in this file.
